entry.title: Marilyn Gatica joins BRAN Lab
entry.content: We’re delighted to welcome Marilyn Gatica, Assistant Professor in AI and Data Science at Northeastern University London, as a faculty member of BRAN Lab. Marilyn works on higher-order interactions and multivariate information theory in brain networks.
